header: Several voices at once, all visible
lead: Two to twelve quote cards in two, three or four columns. Cards stretch to the tallest of their row and the attribution is pushed to the bottom, so the faces land on one line whatever the quotes above them do.

quotes.quote_text: Each card is a figure: a blockquote for the words, a figcaption for the person, and a portrait when one has been uploaded.
quotes.author: The first card
quotes.role: Every card is the same shape

quotes.quote_text: A quote card carries no title, so nothing inside this grid appears in the page outline.
quotes.author: The second card

quotes.quote_text: The marks are drawn by the stylesheet, so the stored text is bare and each language gets its own pair.
quotes.author: The third card
